description: Land Acquisition - Ihalakaragahamua, Mahara D/S Division, Gampaha District
categorisation: This gazette notice is a Land Acquisition Notice published under the Land Acquisition Act, specifically detailing the government's intention to acquire several land lots (Millagahawatta) for public purpose. It contains descriptions of the lands, their locations, extents, claimants, and original claimants, along with procedures for compensation claims. The content is exclusively focused on land acquisition matters, falling squarely under the Land Gazettes category (Type 4).
